name: riverside
description: Riverside podcast and recording platform. Browse recordings, search transcripts, manage content, and publish clips to YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.

interface.longDescription: Search your Riverside archive by what was said in it, browse productions, studios, projects, recordings and transcripts, edit video timelines, and publish or schedule clips to connected social platforms. Requires a Riverside account on a qualifying paid plan; Free and Pro accounts cannot use the MCP.
defaultPrompt: Find the Riverside recording where we talked about fundraising
